title: Transport of global-section pullback along isomorphisms over the coefficient scheme
statement: Let p:Y→X, h:T→Y, rho:L→Y, w:W→T, k:W→L be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme] with wh=k rho. Let g:Z→X, v:V→Z, q:L≅Z and E:W≅V satisfy qg=rho p and Ev=kq. For an abelian etale sheaf G on X [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], there are isomorphisms U:Gamma(L,rho^-1 p^-1 G)≅Gamma(Z,g^-1 G) and B:Gamma(W,w^-1 h^-1 p^-1 G)≅Gamma(V,(vg)^-1 G) [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. The composite of pullback of sections along k, sections of the square inverse-image comparison for wh=k rho, and B equals U followed by pullback along v and sections of the inverse composition comparison [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange, def-weil-pbc-finite-section-pullback].

source.place: Tag 0GJU, proof of lemma-beta-is-isomorphism; Tag 0GJP, equation-alpha-K

proof.text: Construct U by sections of the square coefficient isomorphism and inverse pullback along q. Construct B by reversing pullback along E followed by coefficient composition, the composition comparisons along E,v and k,q, the inverse coefficient square along k, and the original square along w,h. All factors are isomorphisms.

Cancel U inverse on the left and B inverse on the right. Naturality of pullback of global sections moves coefficient maps across the pullbacks. The composition law for k,q and E,v identifies both leading maps. The remaining coefficient maps cancel by functoriality and the isomorphism identities.

theorem globalSections_iso_over_transport
    {X Y T L Z W V : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ X) (h : T ⟶ Y) (ρ : L ⟶ Y)
    (w : W ⟶ T) (k : W ⟶ L) (hw : w ≫ h = k ≫ ρ)
    (g : Z ⟶ X) (v : V ⟶ Z) (q : L ≅ Z) (E : W ≅ V)
    (hq : q.hom ≫ g = ρ ≫ p) (hE : E.hom ≫ v = k ≫ q.hom)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ U : (Sheaf.Γ L.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ρ).obj
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).obj G)) ≅
      (Sheaf.Γ Z.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G),
    ∃ B : (Sheaf.Γ W.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} w).obj
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} h).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).obj G))) ≅
      (Sheaf.Γ V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (v ≫ g)).obj G),
    globalSectionsUpperStarMap AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} k
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ρ).obj
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).obj G)) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ W.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        ((squareUpperStarIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (CommSq.mk hw)).hom.app
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).obj G)) ≫ B.hom =
      U.hom ≫ globalSectionsUpperStarMap AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G) ≫
      (Sheaf.Γ V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} v g).inv.app G)
